subject: Dedicated reservation proposal: cluster sizing & activation scenarios
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@cascadecore.ai>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@cascadecore.ai, procurement@cascadecore.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity options + timeline

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — the latency profile looked promising. We're starting to sketch internal procurement and need a few concrete reservation options for our SRE and product teams to review. High level asks:

- A 50–200 GPU sizing band with clear min-floor commitments
- Suggested ramp schedule to hit peak inference in 9 months
- Fallback/soft-fallback options if we miss ramp milestones
- Any SLA uplift for reserved customers (latency/uptime) and how credits/workarounds would be handled

Can you send a short set of options (small/medium/large) with activation timelines and indicative pricing? Procurement also asked for any sample contract language for activation credits.

Appreciate it — cc'ing ops and procurement for visibility.

Best,
Elena
Elena Park
Head of Infrastructure, CascadeCore
From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@cascadecore.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, ops@cascadecore.ai, procurement@cascadecore.ai
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity options + timeline

Elena — thanks for the clear asks. Attached is a short proposal with three reservation packages and activation paths that map to the ramp milestones you mentioned. Key points summarized below (see attached PDF + spreadsheet for full build-outs):

1) Compact (min 50 GPUs, burst to 80) — 6 month onramp
   - Use case: Product pilot + narrow production tier
   - Autoscale burst to 80 for traffic spikes, prefix caching enabled
   - Activation credits: 20% credit if we miss <30% of committed throughput in month 3

2) Balanced (min 100 GPUs, burst to 180) — 9 month staged ramp (3 x 3-month tranches)
   - Use case: Customer-first production rollout across US regions
   - Warmstart prewarmed nodes for canary weeks, KV cache warmup included
   - SLA: 99.9% uptime on reserved pool, 10ms median tail latency target on common prompts at committed throughput
   - Soft fallback: Auto-route to compatible quantized variant with controlled latency increase if capacity constrained

3) High-throughput (min 200 GPUs, burst to 300+) — 9–12 month aggressive ramp
   - Use case: Full-scale inference for multiple product lines
   - Dedicated allocation across two availability zones for regional redundancy
   - Activation credits: tiered credits tied to missed activation milestones; documented in attachment

I've asked Karthik to confirm the technical constraints (model sizes, quantization support) and Jonas to include a short note on geo-bursting and cross-AZ warmstart costs. Ben will follow up on pricing tiers and contract wording for activation credits.

Attaching: CascadeCore_Dedicated_Options_v1.pdf and activation-schedule-cascadecore.xlsx

Next step: propose a 30-min readout on Thu or Fri to walk through options and align on Balanced vs High-throughput. What time works for your team?

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Elena Park <elena@cascadecore.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, ops@cascadecore.ai
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity options + timeline

Heads up on a couple technical items I flagged in the spreadsheet:

- Model families: If CascadeCore plans to serve both a 30B chat model and a 7B embedding model concurrently, Balanced should be sized toward the higher-context chat workload (we recommend 100 GPUs min for a sustained 95th percentile throughput target).
- Quantization: For the High-throughput path, double-check that the 30B can be run in int8 with acceptable quality for your most-critical prompts; otherwise plan +20% GPU to offset memory pressure.
- Prefix caching: We'll need initial KV cache seeding windows during canary weeks — recommend a 48–72 hour warmstart window prior to public rollouts to avoid cold-token penalties.

I've added inline comments in activation-schedule-cascadecore.xlsx and called out a plan for an early canary (10% traffic) during month 4 for Balanced to verify latency under load.

-Karthik
Principal Applied ML, Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@cascadecore.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, procurement@cascadecore.ai
Date: Fri, 03 Jul 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity options + timeline

Elena / team — pricing and commitment mechanics below (high-level; legal will provide template language):

- Compact: 12-mo term, base monthly fee (min 50 GPUs), $Xk/mo (discounted at commit) + per-token variable overage. 10% activation credit if production SLA not met in first 60 days.
- Balanced: 12–24 mo term (preferred 18 mo), step-up schedule with three tranches (100 -> 140 -> 180). Pricing: blended monthly at mid-commit. Activation credits tiered (5% after tranche 1 miss, 10% after tranche 2 miss).
- High-throughput: 24-mo term, footprint guaranteed (200 min), with burst lanes and cross-AZ reserved. Negotiable premium for isolation and faster support SLAs.

Notes on credits: credits are applied as bill credits (not cash), and are tied to activation acceptance tests (throughput and median latency on a mutually-agreed prompt set). We'll include sample contract clauses in the doc I attach (SLA-exception-request.docx).

If CascadeCore is comfortable with the Balanced path, we can draft an order form that encodes the tranche dates and acceptance criteria. Happy to join your procurement call next week.

-Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Park <elena@cascadecore.ai>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, procurement@cascadecore.ai
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity options + timeline

Thanks — this is helpful and exactly what procurement needed. A couple quick responses: 

- We're leaning to the Balanced option (100 -> 140 -> 180) to match our roadmap and give ops room to validate.
- Acceptance tests: we'll send a short prompt set (10 canonical prompts + load curve) for Redwood to use during each tranche acceptance.
- Contract timing: procurement prefers an 18-mo cadence with the tranche dates encoded and the 5/10% credit schedule Ben outlined.

Let's schedule the readout for Fri 07/09 at 11:00 PT — can your team make that? We'll have procurement and SRE on the call.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Elena
